QUOTE: "Makes a single `client.createPost` call (the same no-retry path)... On failure, it either removes the post (the three "post is no longer valid" error IDs) or sets `failed: true` again. It does not loop."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states `retryFailedPost` makes one attempt with no loop and, on failure, removes the post for the three errors or marks it failed again.
